title: Pagination drops the last item of every page
body:
Calling `TaskStore.paginate(page=1, per_page=2)` with 5 tasks returns only 1 task instead of 2. Every page seems to be one item short.

**Expected:** each page returns up to `per_page` tasks.
**Test:** `tests/test_store.py::test_paginate_returns_full_page`

title: Deleting a completed task raises TaskNotFound
body:
If I complete a task and then try to delete it, `TaskStore.delete()` raises `TaskNotFound` even though the task exists.

**Steps:**
1. `t = store.add('x')`
2. `store.complete(t.id)`
3. `store.delete(t.id)` → raises

**Expected:** completed tasks can be deleted too.
**Test:** `tests/test_store.py::test_delete_completed_task`

title: Search should be case-insensitive
body:
`store.search('milk')` doesn't find a task titled "Buy Milk".

**Expected:** search matches regardless of letter case.
**Test:** `tests/test_store.py::test_search_is_case_insensitive`
